data.name: Vidhu
data.gender_notes: Vidhu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Vidhu means "knowledge, wisdom" in Sanskrit. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'vidh' which means 'to know'. This name is often given to children who are believed to possess great knowledge or intelligence. The name Vidhu carries the meaning “Knowledge, Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Vidhu usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge, wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vidhu is a divine name that represents the goddess of knowledge and wisdom, Saraswati. It is believed that children with this name will be blessed with the gift of knowledge and intelligence, and will be able to use it to make a positive impact on the world.
data.etymology: Vidhu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledge, Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vidhu total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
